result:
test-phase-07 (US6, Adjust settings) passed all 10 checks on attempt 1, so no bugs were filed. I've marked it `done` in `suite.json`. The suite status is still `running`, because test-phase-E2E and test-phase-regression haven't run yet.

**API checks (curl):**
- **A1:** a fresh database returns the default settings: no display name, plan-start notifications on, Dashboard as the default page. `/api/app-info` reports the time zone as Africa/Cairo.
- **A2:** every save is returned unchanged by the next read, for each of the six default-page values. Saving `null` clears the display name.
- **A3:** a 100-character display name is accepted. A 101-character one gets a 400 that names `displayName`, and the saved name stays as it was.
- **A4:** bad, lower-case or missing `defaultPage` values get a 400 naming that field. So do bad, missing or null `planStartNotifications` values. The settings stay unchanged in every case.

**UI checks (Playwright MCP, headless, 10 screenshots):**
- **U1:** the Settings form shows the values the API returns, and the time zone comes from app-info and can't be edited.
- **U2:** saving shows "Settings saved". The new values survive a page reload and a fresh browser context with no shared storage.
- **U3:** the Dashboard greeting reads "Hello, Mona Test", or "Hello" once the name is cleared. Opening `/` lands on whichever of the six default pages is saved.
- **U4:** with notifications off, a plan that started while `/plans` was open showed no notice and no Started badge. With notifications on, the "has started" notice appeared within 0.1 s of the start time, together with the Started badge. This happened on both plans tried.
- **U5:** a 101-character name shows the field error under the name box, and nothing is saved.
- **U6:** the Settings link reaches `/settings` from all six pages.

The browser console showed one error: the 400 that U5 is meant to trigger. The report lists three minor observations that I didn't file as bugs:
- The name box accepts more than 100 characters as you type; the limit is only applied when you save.
- At the moment a plan-start notice appeared, the plan card still read "Not Started" until the page's next refresh.
- The Started badge disappears after a reload.

The run also stalled for about 27 minutes between the API and UI checks while waiting for tool approval. No single check spans that gap.
